2- It is also therefore a table of contents for Part 1: Agent Fundamentals, showing where each of the key components is explained in details.

item.title: Jay Alammar：Fascinating!
item.description:
Fascinating!

Elephants talk with deep rumbles, alone or overlapping like a choir, and this research found the sounds carry a rough clue about what's happening (meeting up, staying in touch, deciding to move), whether it's one elephant or many.

In a chorus, each elephant uses the kind of rumble that fits the situation, and in some situations, especially when coordinating plans, their voices drift to sound more alike as the conversation goes on.

item.description:
"Music is a hidden exercise in arithmetic by a soul that does not know it is counting." ~Leibniz

Schopenhauer: That is quite accurate from a lower standpoint and may be parodied in the following way to suit our higher view of music:

Music is "a hidden exercise in metaphysics by a soul that does not know it is philosophising."
